---
title: "05_analysis_1: PCA of hippocampus and DLPFC samples"
format: html
---

## Aim

Use principal component analysis (PCA) to see whether samples group by brain region (hippocampus vs. dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, DLPFC) or by developmental age.

## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
```

## Load data

Temporary input: the region-specific BrainSpan expression matrices in `data/_external/`. When `03_augment.qmd` writes `data/03_dat_aug.tsv`, switch to that file.

```{r}
#| message: false
hip_raw <- read_csv(file = "../data/_external/BrainSpan_HIPPOCAMPUS_expression_matrix.csv",
                    name_repair = "unique_quiet")
dlpfc_raw <- read_csv(file = "../data/_external/BrainSpan_DLPFC_expression_matrix.csv",
                      name_repair = "unique_quiet")
```

## Tidy data

One row per gene and sample. The age is stored in the column names as log10(age in years + 0.7), where negative ages are prenatal.

```{r}
expr_long <- bind_rows(
  hip_raw |>
    rename(gene_id = 1) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene_id,
                 names_to = "sample",
                 values_to = "expression") |>
    mutate(region = "Hippocampus"),
  dlpfc_raw |>
    rename(gene_id = 1) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene_id,
                 names_to = "sample",
                 values_to = "expression") |>
    mutate(region = "DLPFC")
) |>
  mutate(sample_id = str_c(region, "_", sample),
         log_age = sample |>
           str_remove("^Human_Age_log10Yrs_plus0.7_") |>
           str_remove("[.]{3}[0-9]+$") |>
           as.numeric(),
         age_years = 10^log_age - 0.7,
         age_group = case_when(age_years < 0 ~ "Prenatal",
                               age_years < 2 ~ "Infant",
                               age_years < 12 ~ "Child",
                               age_years < 20 ~ "Adolescent",
                               TRUE ~ "Adult"),
         age_group = factor(age_group,
                            levels = c("Prenatal", "Infant", "Child",
                                       "Adolescent", "Adult")))
```

## Select genes

Keep expressed genes (mean expression of at least 1), log2-transform, and use the 1000 most variable genes.

```{r}
expr_log <- expr_long |>
  group_by(gene_id) |>
  filter(mean(expression) >= 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(log2_expr = log2(expression + 1))

top_genes <- expr_log |>
  group_by(gene_id) |>
  summarise(variance = var(log2_expr)) |>
  slice_max(variance, n = 1000)

sample_info <- expr_log |>
  distinct(sample_id, region, log_age, age_years, age_group)

expr_wide <- expr_log |>
  semi_join(top_genes, by = "gene_id") |>
  select(sample_id, gene_id, log2_expr) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = gene_id,
              values_from = log2_expr) |>
  left_join(sample_info, by = "sample_id")
```

## PCA

```{r}
pca_fit <- expr_wide |>
  select(starts_with("ENSG")) |>
  prcomp(scale. = TRUE)

pca_scores <- pca_fit |>
  augment(expr_wide |> select(sample_id, region, log_age, age_years, age_group))

pca_variance <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues")

pc1_pct <- pca_variance |> filter(PC == 1) |> pull(percent)
pc2_pct <- pca_variance |> filter(PC == 2) |> pull(percent)
```

## Plots

### Samples on PC1 and PC2

```{r}
pl_scores <- pca_scores |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1,
             y = .fittedPC2,
             colour = age_group,
             shape = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "PCA of hippocampus and DLPFC samples",
       x = str_c("PC1 (", scales::percent(pc1_pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")"),
       y = str_c("PC2 (", scales::percent(pc2_pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")"),
       colour = "Age group",
       shape = "Region") +
  theme_minimal()

pl_scores
```

### Variance explained

```{r}
pl_variance <- pca_variance |>
  filter(PC <= 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC,
             y = percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Variance explained by the first 10 PCs",
       x = "Principal component",
       y = "Variance explained") +
  theme_minimal()

pl_variance
```

### PC1 across development

```{r}
pl_pc1_age <- pca_scores |>
  ggplot(aes(x = log_age,
             y = .fittedPC1,
             colour = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess",
              formula = y ~ x,
              se = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log10(0.7),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "PC1 across development (dashed line = birth)",
       x = "Age, log10(years + 0.7)",
       y = "PC1",
       colour = "Region") +
  theme_minimal()

pl_pc1_age
```

## Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = "../results/05_pca_scores.png",
       plot = pl_scores,
       width = 7,
       height = 5,
       bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = "../results/05_pca_variance.png",
       plot = pl_variance,
       width = 7,
       height = 5,
       bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = "../results/05_pca_pc1_age.png",
       plot = pl_pc1_age,
       width = 7,
       height = 5,
       bg = "white")
```

## Key findings

- PC1 explains `r scales::percent(pc1_pct, accuracy = 0.1)` of the variation and follows age: prenatal samples are separated from postnatal samples.
- Most of the change along PC1 happens before and around birth and levels off during childhood.
- Hippocampus and DLPFC follow almost the same trajectory on PC1, so developmental age has a much larger effect than brain region.
- Region differences are clearest among prenatal samples on PC2 (`r scales::percent(pc2_pct, accuracy = 0.1)`).
- One prenatal DLPFC sample groups with the postnatal samples and could be an outlier.
